class.name: SlatePanel
class.brief_description: The conversation surface drawn on a slate's screen.
class.description: A dark, self-contained UI for a [ClaudeSession]: a streaming transcript, collapsible tool cards, an input line and a status strip showing the room and session state. [AgentSlate3D] creates one by default; you can also drop it into any 2D scene and call [method bind_session]. The panel never decides permissions. It shows a request and re-emits it as [signal permission_requested].

method.name: append_system_text
method.description: Adds a small, muted line to the transcript.

method.name: append_user_text
method.description: Adds a user line to the transcript without sending it.

method.name: bind_room
method.description: Shows the room's name and directory in the status strip.

method.name: bind_session
method.description: Connects the panel to a session's signals. Passing [code]null[/code] disconnects.

method.name: focus_input
method.description: Gives keyboard focus to the input line.

method.name: submit
method.description: Appends [param text] as a user line and sends it to the bound session.

members.member: Font size for transcript and input text.
